Sometimes we don’t know what to pray. Here is a prayer to pray over your husband while he is sleeping. 😴

Did you know a single pedicure can take up to eight hours these days? / My husband, who is coming home to me and our two young children today after seven days on the road, couldn’t believe it either. / Sadly 9 a.m to 5 p.m. was the only appointment time available for this Saturday. 🥲

Usually, my husband does the morning routine before me, but he had a late night at work and needed to sleep in a bit, so I went first this morning. / Me: I’m going to jump in the shower, but I’ll leave the door unlocked in case you need anything. / He comes in 5 minutes later, pulls the curtain aside, and leans against the wall, arms crossed over his chest.
I miss my handsome future husband
My husband just found / A cockroach / In his CPAP reservoir
My husband walking around: “there are so many fcking dog beds in this house!” / Me to our dogs: “yeah guys, stop buying beds FFS!” / Dog and dog bed tax: ⬇️

My husband, watching me use baking soda to clean a burnt pan: “baking soda? Huh, I never would have thought to use that.” / Me: “it’s abrasive enough to get stuff off without scratching anything. You went to the top culinary school in the nation, what the heck did they teach you?” / Hubs, a distant and haunted look in his eyes: “So many ways to cook eggs. So. Many.”
I’m trying to prove a point to my husband. Our TODDLER ate half my sub, laid down for a nap, woke up demanding food, and ate 7 Dino nuggets. Moms, What’s about to happen?

Well, we have no following and no idea what we’re doing, but my husband and I have decided to live out our wildest dreams of opening a spooky-themed traveling bookshop, and rationality aside, this feels like the BEST plan ever 👻🦇🪞🗝️📖🕸️
My husband received a great job offer today but my son got to ride the bus for the first time on a field trip to the apple orchard so I’m not sure which one of them had a better day.

Being a mom is wild. My husband is home today and is doing a telehealth visit with our daughter because she’s sick. He scheduled the appt. They call me for the triage call and I do it. Then I let them know I will not be reachable during the visit due to being at work and her dad will be there. I receive 8 consecutive phone calls while my husband is literally in the virtual waiting room of the appt. Then the appt is cancelled because they couldn’t reach me. Mind you, his number is on file.
If I can smell your laundry from the street, you’re using way too much detergent

Forget perfume 😂 what are y’all washing your clothes with that has people stopping you asking what you’re wearing?? I need the detergent, scent beads, fabric softener, dryer sheets THE WHOLE RECIPE. Don’t gatekeep 😭

It’s my coworker’s birthday, so I bought her a cheesecake. / We’re not particularly close. We don’t even text. But last year, she mentioned that her husband buys her an ice cream cake every birthday because that’s what the kids like. / She prefers cheesecake. / Anyway, she’s getting cheesecake for her birthday this year.
Real men actually study their wife. What calms her, what shuts her down, what she needs without saying it.
Unpopular opinion: “Happy wife, happy life” is the worst marriage advice.
393 days as your wife, forever to go ♾️💍 / Happy 1st Wedding Anniversary 🤍
So do all men have a work wife?
A wife is basically a free private chef 😭😂

May my husband’s pockets never run dry, his blessings never run out, and his hard work always pay off. May God continue to bless him abundantly. He deserves all the good things this life has to offer. 🤍🙏🏻
